taps.phrase: to stand still like a mannequin

story: Two friends dress a mannequin in a shirt outside a shop.
Then the woman raises the mannequin's arm and wraps a scarf around its neck.
Her friend stands still like a mannequin, and she can't tell which one to carry inside!
notes: Jump cut at ~4.3 s (scarf appears instantly between 4.26 and 4.38 s, cuts/sheet row 1), and the framing jumps wider at ~5.5-6.0 s when the man appears; so exercise 1 is skipped despite 3 targets. Hands of a second helper are visible at 0-1.5 s, so 'dress' was avoided as a tap (also a carousel caption). 'a mannequin's arm' slot is on the raised forearm/hand.
